name: clubsphere-workspace
description: ClubSphere - The Digital Operating System for Collegiate Student Organizations

scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('backend/.env')&&fs.existsSync('.env.example')){fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','backend/.env');console.log('✓ Created backend/.env from .env.example');}" && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run format:check --workspace=frontend && node -e "console.log('✓ Code style & format check passed 100%')"
